items.title: Condor A320 Misses Frankfurt Curfew By Seconds, Denied Landing At 875 Feet
items.summary: On September 11th, Condor flight DE1809 missed the strict midnight curfew at Frankfurt Airport by mere seconds, adding hours of travel time for its passengers. The plane was forced to abandon its landing at the very last moment and divert to Cologne. It’s not the first time this has happened at a German airport and we feel confident in saying that it won’t be the last!

items.title: 曼谷洪災造成航班大亂、行李滯留 泰航執行長遭停職
